title: Astrid and the Ledger
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: Gideon Eriksen, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
